cases.name: Sheryl Mae Turner
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She was a shining light to all who knew her, with a kind and loving personality that radiated through her beautiful smile and touched the hearts of those around her. Sheryl's gentle soul left an indelible mark on everyone she met and will be forever remembered for her warmth and compassion.

In the face of tragic circumstances, Sheryl's unwavering spirit continued to inspire those closest to her. She faced life with courage and grace, leaving behind a legacy of love and strength that will endure through the memories shared by family and friends."
cases.narrative: On 1/24/2024, her torso was discovered by a hunter in the Ouachita River in Catahoula Parish, LA. The autopsy report indicated she was allegedly sexually assaulted by Holland and her neck was broken. Holland allegedly admitted to picking her up in New Iberia and said he brought the her to his home where they planned to engage in a relationship. Although Holland gave multiple different statements, he admitted that he committed the victim’s sexual abuse injuries, officials said. Holland also allegedly admitted that he killed her inside his apartment during a sexual act. After he realized she was dead, he allegedly dismembered her with a large kitchen knife.
